infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: NearDeal needs camera access to scan QR codes for deal redemption.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: NearDeal needs photo library access to upload deal images.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: NearDeal uses your location to set the deal location on the map.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: NearDeal uses your background location to notify you about nearby deals as you move around.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow NearDeal to access your camera for QR code scanning.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow NearDeal to use your location to set the deal position on the map.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow NearDeal to use your background location to notify you about nearby deals.
